requirements.text: Customers can choose their preferred barber.
Customers can find and choose an available time slot.
Customers can change or cancel their appointments without needing to call.
Automated reminders via text or email one day and one hour before appointments.
Customer accounts to store personal details and past bookings.
The system should be affordable and straightforward.
The system should allow online payments via credit and debit cards, with cash payment options available at the shop.
The booking system should be accessible via a website and possibly a mobile app.
